about: OUTLETRULES-v1 (agent-instructions2, 2026-10-28): outlet matching from the retired workbook tab 'Reprint info' (B14, B40-B42), read by sheet_task.norm_outlet(name, city). Keys are normalized names (lower case, accents folded, punctuation -> space, "Today's Edition" / ': Blogs' / ', The' / leading 'The' removed). feeds: a name starting with the prefix is that outlet. generic_needs_city: such a name is one outlet per Outlet city (key 'name@city'; blank city = the bare name). aliases: key (normalized name, or 'name@city' for a generic one) -> the outlet's key. keep_separate: groups that must never fold into one (unit-tested). 'week' is not generic: The Week's editions are one outlet (B40).

aliases.jewish journal: jewish journal of greater los angeles
aliases.daily bruin: daily bruin university of california los angeles

about_v2: REPRINT-v2 (reprint-code, 2026-10-28): "types" = outlet key (sheet_task.norm_outlet) -> [type, house]. Types: wire, nonprofit, prservice, aggregator, distributor (TCA/TNS/U-Wire), chain, independent, station, network, podcast, magazine, blog, trade, institution, foreign, national, other. House = publisher group (same house = never a date-only Original swap; sibling re-runs). Outlets not in the table are classified by reprint_rule.classify_outlet (name / Medium / publisher rules) and listed by sheet_task (outlet_untyped). "services" = originating services an ORIGINCREDIT credit can name: canonical -> {outlet: regex on the outlet key, credit: regex on bylines / text, cs: case-sensitive}; the credited service ranks first (tier 0). "blocked_hosts": sites whose pages cannot be fetched; a proven originator there is added as a no-copy Original row (Sammy 2026-10-28). "av_items": AV tab Item types that are never reprints.

KFF Health News.credit: kff health news|kaiser health news|california healthline

fetch_blocked_hosts_note: DRIFT-2 (final-int 2026-10-29): hosts the Update button never fetches (bot wall / paywall / login). The page skips the union of fetch_blocked_hosts and blocked_hosts (blocked_hosts = credited originators added without a copy, REPRINT-v2); both reach the page through the `fetchrules` block (build_data.py).
never_coverage_note: REQ-12 / NOBLOGS-v1 (updfix 2026-10-30): platform hosts whose subdomains/user pages are personal spaces are never press. Matched by host suffix (or host + path prefix for medium.com/@). An outlets.json record for the exact host rescues a journalist's Substack/Medium. lookup_cache.json never_coverage_hosts adds YouTube and advocacy blogs (NOBLOGS-v1).
houses_note: REQ-14 (updfix 2026-10-30): one house = one newsroom: copies across its outlets are editions of one row, never Original + Reprint. The 'types' table carries the house for each outlet key (row_house); 'hosts' lists the sites. KNX News is CBS Audacy, not iHeart.
